description: Verify that from ESTABLISHED, DUT acknowledges each tester data segment with a cumulative ACK at the expected ack_num (RFC 793 §3.4 / §3.7)
approach:
[Objective]
In-order data delivery → cumulative ACK after each segment. Three sequential segments must each produce an ACK whose ack_num equals the sum of received bytes.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake.
2. Tester → DUT: seg #1, #2, #3 (each with N bytes).
3. Observation: DUT acks each at I+N, I+2N, I+3N.

[Pass condition]
All 3 ACKs observed with correct ack_num.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_timeout_seg<n> — no DUT ACK for segment n

verdicts.Pass: DUT cumulative-acked 3 sequential data segments — normal
